research_disposition.data: Small mixed feature gains; source/target and v3 baseline replay verified.
research_disposition.architecture: Upper quantile improves poor+ sensitivity with accuracy/false-alarm cost; quantile coverage below nominal .9.
research_disposition.safety: All candidates miss 13 severe hours across five episodes. Development has zero severe hours. No promotion evidence.

limitations: Research-informed fixed 2x3 factorial ablation on exact consumed v3 archive. All settings fixed; development and diagnostics do not select candidates. Six severe training episodes only. No probability calibration for regressors, no pristine holdout, deployment or medical safety claim.
